insights:
OpenAI doubled the price of its GPT-5.6 Sol line, effective today. GPT-5.6 Sol went from $4.67 to $9.33 per million tokens, a 100% increase; the batch tier moved $2.33 to $4.67, and Sol Pro and gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh saw the same doubling. That is the largest single move in the changelog and applies across every Sol variant listed.

Other hikes were smaller but broad. Z.ai's GLM 5 rose 67%, from $1.04 to $1.73, and MoonshotAI's Kimi Latest climbed 63%, from $5.04 to $8.21. Against that, four cuts landed: GLM 5.1 fell 27% to $1.66, Mistral Small 3.2 24B dropped 20% to $0.117, Gemini Pro Latest slipped 12% to $4.67, and MiniMax M2.5 eased 8% to $0.497. On capability, Llama 4 Scout lost 1.6 points (8.1 to 6.5) and Llama 4 Maverick fell 0.7 points (10.0 to 9.3).

A large batch of legacy model entries was added with no intelligence scores or prices attached, so they carry no ranking weight yet. In speed, K2 Horizon 375B A23B jumped from 116 to 480 tokens per second, a 315% gain. Data quality was normal today.
